lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where council takes up third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — a vote that would amend Telluride's Land Use Code to change historic review standards and landscaping rules for fire mitigation, touching property owners across town. Thursday, the Town kicks off its goal-setting retreat for 2027, and the week opens with the Telluride Jazz Festival running through the weekend.

notable.stake: Final vote on wildfire code that reshapes historic review and landscaping rules.
2027 priorities set here will drive the town budget and staff direction all year.
Three multifamily projects reviewed, including a conditional-use permit decision.
